calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.store_weeks, ty.stores, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year;

WITH fact AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(v) AS net
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  ) x
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.dt
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2
), rpt AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(f.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_year) AS fy, COUNT(*) AS n_stores, SUM(f.net) AS fact_net, SUM(r.rpt_net) AS rpt_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(f.net,0)-coalesce(r.rpt_net,0))>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stores_diff
FROM fact f FULL JOIN rpt r ON r.store_id=f.store_id AND r.fiscal_year=f.fiscal_year
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 'store' AS k, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) AS a, store_name AS b, CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR) AS c, CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR) AS d, region AS e FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND (open_date IS NOT NULL OR close_date IS NOT NULL OR store_id>=900)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), closure_type, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupes_sales_line', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupes_return', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'distinct_stores_current', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT store_id) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900;

WITH x AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS days_rows, sum(CASE WHEN r.net_sales>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_sales, sum(r.net_sales) AS net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY ALL
), s AS (
  SELECT store_id, fiscal_week, sum(net) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27') AS ty, sum(net) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AS ly,
         min(days_sales) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27') AS ty_days, min(days_sales) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AS ly_days
  FROM x GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT s.store_id, st.store_name, st.region, s.fiscal_week, round(ty,0) AS ty, round(ly,0) AS ly, round(100*(ty/ly-1),1) AS g, ty_days, ly_days
FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=s.store_id AND st.is_current
WHERE ty IS NULL OR ly IS NULL OR ty_days<7 OR ly_days<7 OR abs(ty/ly-1)>0.25 OR ty<=0
ORDER BY 1,4;

WITH params AS (

),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM params
JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year;
